title: 第15章 小蛇腾黑第16章 探险一
slug: 重生之为蚁第816章未知岛屿
content_zh:
小黑蛇，终于脱离了担惊受怕的日子，现在也不用为食物发愁了。这段时间，不但天天有好吃好喝的，而且可以睡到自然醒。虽然，主人有时候老是揍他，但这更坚定了小黑蛇抱紧这大腿的决心。主人正在考验自己，一定是的，小黑蛇一直这么认为。
当然，相比于滋润的小黑蛇，孙云可就郁闷多了。自从捡了这条小黑蛇，孙云简直成了保姆，多了一个小祖宗。这小黑蛇，就像是饿死鬼脱胎，什么肉都吃。开始还好，毕竟吃的少，可最近越来越能吃了。
本来就食物不多的队伍，怎么养的起这个大胃王，可是赶了几次都赶不走，孙云都要疯了。
“主人，我想出去历练一下。”
终于有一天，小黑蛇终于开窍了。
随着这段时间的接触，小黑蛇发现了一个问题。孙云身边的战友们，虽然实力都很强大，但都对孙云都言听计从，从来没见过反抗的。
从侧面打听下，小黑蛇才知道，这些都是在孙云照顾下长大的。每一个战士，都是在千万精英中拼搏上来的，都能为孙云独当一面。小蛇突然感觉自己很没用，实力没有，手下也没兵，主人会不会很讨厌自己。
“决定了，很辛苦的哦？”
孙云掩饰住激动，语重心长的问道！
“嗯！”小黑蛇坚定的点点蛇头！
小黑蛇现在，对孙云可是佩服的五体投地，威武雄壮体型，竟然还会飞！尤其是打仗的时候，非常的勇猛，总是冲在最前面。
“从你细长的体型来看，应该属于蛇类。蛇相对于蟒蛇来说虽然都属于蛇类，但战斗力差很多。但是，万事也不是绝对，蛇虽然没有蟒蛇体型大，但速度却是强项。去红头将军那里，以普通兵士的标准通过了，你就可以出去了。如没通过，私自离队了，你就永远不要回来，去吧。”
孙云语重心长的说道。
虽然，孙云不太喜欢这小黑蛇，但毕竟是自己一天天养起来的。以这小黑蛇的体型，确实很难生存下去，必须让红头练练！
“是！主人，请赐小蛇一个名字吧。”
小黑蛇听到孙云的分析，期盼的望着孙云。
小黑蛇听说，每个人都有名字，它也想有个名字。它既然打算一直跟着孙云，自然愿意让孙云给他取个名。毕竟，孙云的名字挺特别的，不像其它的同伴，都是些石头、木头、土块什么的！
“腾黑，希望你能飞黄腾达，战斗中腹黑。你一记住，蛇是冷血动物，偷袭才是你的强项。行走于黑夜，对敌人黑心，偷袭为主要方向，永远不要理会光明正大的说法。”
孙云认真的说完，就转身离去了。其实，孙云自己都不知道咧咧了些什么，干脆赶紧开溜了。
小蛇腾黑，看着孙云远去的背影，心里颇为感慨。孙云自己都不知道，这条不起眼的小蛇，以后将是他默契的伙伴，屡屡救自己性命。

……
小蛇腾黑，经过红头的训练，成长的可谓突飞猛进，身体也更加结实了。潜伏、侦察、水中作战这都是腾黑信手拈来的技能了。至于负重越野，高空坠落虽然有些困难，但也练的算过了关。
蛇不缺乏耐性，戏水也是天性，但能负重越野的蛇，可没有出现过。负重越野训练，直接练就了小蛇腾黑的速度和力量，远超其它蛇类。
更恐怖的是，你见过蛇从百丈高的大树上，直接跳下来攻击的么？吓一跳不说，重点是还是条毒蛇。
呲呲……
此时，小蛇腾黑，四处打量着这个奇特的洞穴。这个洞穴颇为宽大，高度大概有四米，而且有一些天然石钟乳。
从石钟乳的块头来看，这应该是一个比较典型的岩洞穴，而且存在的时间绝对不会短。也不知道几千年，还是几万年的时间累积，才能养出那么大的石钟乳，太不可思议了。
一路上腾黑有些心不在焉，不过他的速度却并没有因此而减慢，没有用太长的时间，便到了洞穴底部。
content_en:
The little black snake has finally escaped from the days of fear, and now he no longer has to worry about food. During this period, not only can I have delicious food and drink every day, but I can also sleep until I wake up naturally. Although the master always beat him sometimes, this strengthened the little black snake's determination to hug this thigh tightly. The master is testing himself, it must be so, the little black snake has always thought so.
Of course, compared to the moist little black snake, Sun Yun was much more depressed. Since picking up this little black snake, Sun Yun has become a nanny and has a little ancestor. This little black snake is like a starving ghost, it will eat any kind of meat. It was okay at first, after all, I ate less, but recently I have been able to eat more and more.
How could the team that didn't have much food support this big eater? But they couldn't drive him away after several attempts, and Sun Yun was going crazy.
"Master, I want to go out and practice."
Finally one day, the little black snake finally enlightened.
With this period of contact, the little black snake discovered a problem. Although the comrades around Sun Yun were very powerful, they all obeyed Sun Yun's words and had never seen anyone resist.
After inquiring from the side, the little black snake found out that these people had grown up under Sun Yun's care. Every warrior has fought hard among tens of millions of elites, and they can all play their part for Sun Yun. The little snake suddenly felt that he was useless. He had no strength and no soldiers. His master would hate him very much.
"It's decided. It's been very hard, huh?"
Sun Yun concealed his excitement and asked earnestly!
"Yeah!" The little black snake nodded firmly!
The little black snake is now in awe of Sun Yun. He has a mighty and majestic figure, and he can even fly! Especially when fighting, he is very brave and always rushes to the front.
"Judging from your slender body shape, you should belong to the snake class. Although snakes are snakes compared to pythons, their combat effectiveness is much lower. However, everything is not absolute. Although snakes are not as big as pythons, their speed is their strong point. Go to the red-headed general and pass the standard of an ordinary soldier, and you can go out. If you fail to pass and leave the team privately, you should never come back. Go ahead."
Sun Yun said seriously.
Although Sun Yun didn't like this little black snake very much, he raised it day by day after all. With the size of this little black snake, it is really difficult to survive. The red head must be given some practice!
"Yes! Master, please give the little snake a name."
The little black snake heard Sun Yun's analysis and looked at Sun Yun expectantly.
The little black snake heard that everyone has a name, and it wanted to have a name too. Since it planned to follow Sun Yun all the time, it was naturally willing to let Sun Yun give him a name. After all, Sun Yun's name is quite special. Unlike his other companions, who are all made of stones, wood, or clods of earth!
"Teng Hei, I hope you will be successful in your career and be scheming in battle. Remember, snakes are cold-blooded animals, and sneak attacks are your strength. Walk in the dark, be ruthless towards the enemy, and take sneak attacks as your main direction. Never pay attention to what is said to be fair and aboveboard."
After Sun Yun finished speaking seriously, he turned around and left. In fact, Sun Yun himself didn't know what he was talking about, so he simply ran away.
Little Snake Tenghei looked at Sun Yun's retreating figure, feeling quite emotional in his heart. Sun Yun himself didn't know that this humble little snake would be his tacit partner in the future, saving his life many times.
…
The little snake Tenghei, after being trained by the red head, has grown by leaps and bounds, and his body has become stronger. Lurking, reconnaissance, and water combat are all skills Tenghei has come to know at his fingertips. As for the weight-bearing cross-country, although falling from a high altitude is a bit difficult, I can pass it with practice.
Snakes do not lack patience, and it is natural to play in water, but there has never been a snake that can carry heavy loads and go off-road. The weight-bearing cross-country training directly developed the speed and strength of the little snake Tenghei, which is far superior to other snakes.
What’s even more terrifying is, have you ever seen a snake jump directly from a tree hundreds of feet high to attack? startledNot to mention, the point is that it is still a poisonous snake.
Sigh...
At this time, the little snake turned black and looked around at this strange cave. This cave is quite wide, about four meters high, and has some natural stalactites.
Judging from the size of the stalactites, this should be a relatively typical rock cave, and its existence will definitely not be short. I don’t know if it took thousands of years or tens of thousands of years to grow such a large stalactite. It’s incredible.
Tenghei was a little distracted along the way, but his speed did not slow down because of this. It didn't take too long to reach the bottom of the cave.
